groups.name: cratis.arc.observability
groups.description: Micrometer observations and correlation propagation for Arc execution pipelines.

properties.name: cratis.arc.observability.enabled
properties.description: Whether Arc command, query, observable-query, authentication, and identity-detail observations are enabled.

properties.name: cratis.arc.observability.correlation-baggage-enabled
properties.description: Whether correlation identifiers are placed in OpenTelemetry baggage when the OpenTelemetry API is available.

properties.name: cratis.arc.observability.correlation-logging-enabled
properties.description: Whether correlation identifiers are placed in the SLF4J MDC when the SLF4J API is available.
